dataset.compatibility_note: The measurement-grounded change-VQA specialist answers occurrence/location/extent/NDVI-NDWI-direction questions. It declines semantic-class questions (e.g. building type) by design. The published CDVQA field schema is unverified here; a documented JSONL adapter (ml.evaluation.change_vqa.load_samples) converts a real release. Coverage is always reported next to accuracy.
